text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To an Umamusume, the Twinkle<n>Series is
synonymous with dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hair-raising clashes, passion that<n>permeates one's
whole body,<n>frenzied stampedes down the stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Countless hopefuls reach for the<n>throne, for honor,
glory, and the<n>realization of dreams they've
harbored since childhood.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And their dreams become the dreams<n>of all who
watch from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Some are enchanted by the Cinderella<n>story of a
runner emerging from<n>humble rural origins out into
the<n>national spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Some see their hopes and ideals<n>embodied in the
prideful scions of a<n>prestigious family.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And some...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ineeeees! Big Siiis!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Some see her running in the rain, a<n>wide grin across
her face even as<n>sweat drips from her brow, and
can't<n>help but share her smile, and her<n>dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
More than anyone, you just want me<n>to have a
good time racing. Can I<n>count on you to always
push me to<n>have fun?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, knew it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not going to run for you,<n>y'know. I run for
myself!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone's cheers be a<n>burden. I'll let
them be my strength<n>instead, and then use that
strength to<n>zoom across the finish line!
choice_data_list: If that's what works for you, it works for me!
If that's what works for you, it works for me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I thought you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, so what if we made our next<n>race another one
with heaps of<n>dreams riding on it?
choice_data_list: You mean like the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's exactly what I was<n>thinking! Let's
take on the world! I<n>know there are gonna be all
kinds of<n>racers taking part...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But I also know that I'm gonna enjoythe race more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Ines Fujin and I begin<n>our
preparations for the Japan Cup.
